name: Squeaky Stuff
source:
A short visual novel about two girls discovering new things about each other through transformation and a magical book.  

[From [url=https://snowpaws.itch.io/squeaky-stuff]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇视觉小说，讲述两个女孩如何通过变身和一本魔法书，认识彼此身上过去未曾见过的一面。
